title: MINOR IN RELIGION AND SOCIETY Religious Studies

sections.heading: MINOR IN RELIGION AND SOCIETY
lines: 1.5 courses normally taken in second year: Religious Studies 2200F/G, Religious Studies 2203F/G, Religious Studies 2204F/G.

0.5 course in Sociology from: Sociology 2105A/B, Sociology 2108F/G, Sociology 2131A/B, Sociology 2145A/B, Sociology 2211F/G, Sociology 2248A/B, Sociology 3342F/G, Sociology 3354F/G, Sociology 3390F/G, Sociology 3391F/G.
2.0 additional courses in Religious Studies, Islamic Studies or Jewish Studies at the 2100 level or above*, except Religious Studies 2208U, Religious Studies 3308U and Religious Studies 4408Y.
*Strongly recommended: completing a 0.5 course in Islamic Studies and a 0.5 course in Jewish Studies.

Note: This module requires Religious Studies 2203F/G, which has Religious Studies 1023E as an antirequisite. Students who have completed Religious Studies 1023E must substitute an alternate 0.5 course in Religious Studies at the 2200 level.
